fit.title: Cash-flow DCF
fit.reason: Capital spending and financing affect a pipeline’s distributable cash. Value the operating cash flows and cross-check the dividend and comparable enterprise multiples.
fit.caution: Review maintenance versus growth capex, leverage and the sustainability of cash distributions.
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.
